initialize.instructions: Private lifecycle tools use the lucia_assurance_ prefix for Lucia's registered assurance and matter-opening workflows. Do not use it for archive search, email, messaging, or unrelated workflows.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_studio_archive_status
tools.title: Check Lucia Studio Archive status
tools.description: Read the local Studio Archive configuration, exact available scopes, refresh state, index counts, and named evidence gaps. Call this before searching. A fresh session can revalidate the approved private-profile root and save isolated session configuration; no client is created.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_list_studio_archive_clients
tools.title: List Studio Archive clients
tools.description: List registered client and orphaned-profile records using stable IDs, display labels, status, and private-identity counts. Stored email addresses, legal names, and tax identifiers remain local. Healthy clients remain usable when directory_complete or identity_registry_complete is false; report the returned issues. An incomplete directory does not prove a client is absent and must not trigger duplicate registration.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_get_studio_client_folder
tools.title: Get one Studio Archive client folder
tools.description: Return a digest-bound folder record for one stable registered client. Other Lucia workflows use this record to reject cross-client inputs and namespace engagement runs.

client_id.description: Stable client_id returned by Studio Archive.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_create_studio_archive_client
tools.title: Create a new Studio Archive client
tools.description: After the user explicitly chooses New client, create a safely named top-level folder, assign a stable client ID independent of that folder name, and register the confirmed identity. For work starting from supplied files, first check_studio_import_sources for all selected files and resolve any unavailable inputs. This begins but does not complete Lucia's New Client professional workflow.

legal_name.description: Confirmed client legal name; Vera derives the folder label.

email_addresses.description: Optional confirmed full email or PEC addresses.

tax_identifiers.description: Optional confirmed codice fiscale or partita IVA values.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_import_studio_client_document
tools.title: Import a document into one client engagement
tools.description: Copy one authorized source, journal, or support file from this computer into the selected engagement with an immutable byte receipt. Check file access with check_studio_import_sources before creating any client or engagement for file-based work. If import fails, disclose and reuse the returned client_id and engagement_id; never create duplicates to retry. For a user-authorized document-only continuation, save the clearly identified Lucia-derived follow-up with role support; a chat-workspace copy alone is not saved engagement progress. Reuse established client/copy authority, then re-list the engagement and read back the controlled copy before reporting a successful save.

source_path.description: Absolute path to the selected source/journal/support file, including a derived follow-up prepared under the user's authority to continue this engagement.

expected_sha256.description: Original attachment SHA-256 when importing a transferred file. Rechecked during copying so an altered transfer cannot be registered.

engagement_id.description: Exact engagement selected or created before this separate import action.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_create_studio_client_engagement
tools.title: Create a Studio Archive client engagement
tools.description: Create one durable engagement and managed input folder for an exact registered client without assuming a journal or any other document type. For work starting from supplied files, check_studio_import_sources must first establish access to all selected inputs; warn and resolve unavailable inputs before creation. Documentless work does not require a file check.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_list_studio_client_engagements
tools.title: List one client's Studio engagements
tools.description: List durable engagements, imported receipts (including saved derived support notes), persisted runs and available output paths. Resume from these records without chat history. An engagement can have follow-up notes without a workflow run. Verify a new document-only continuation's import receipt here before reporting that it is saved.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_prepare_studio_client_workflow
tools.title: Prepare a client-bound Lucia workflow run
tools.description: Prepare or replay one exact customer-folder run bound to selected immutable input receipts and upstream artifacts. A repeated request is idempotent; new_run must be explicit.

input_ids.description: Exact imported input IDs selected for this run.

new_run.description: True only when the user explicitly requests a separate run. Reuse the same idempotency_key for safe retries and choose a new key for another distinct run.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_start_studio_client_workflow
tools.title: Start a Lucia workflow run
tools.description: Move one exact prepared or failed run to running after its input receipts still validate.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_fail_studio_client_workflow
tools.title: Record a Lucia workflow failure
tools.description: Retain a failed run and record a bounded reason instead of treating its output folder as available.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_cancel_studio_client_workflow
tools.title: Cancel a Lucia workflow run
tools.description: Explicitly cancel one abandoned non-terminal run without deleting it.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_finalize_studio_client_workflow
tools.title: Finalize Lucia workflow artifacts
tools.description: Finalize the professional outputs of one exact Archive run and mark them ready for review. Every run of the 13 selected pipelines retains its local privacy report, with missing measurements explicit. The completed, failed or cancelled Archive write closes the report and registers its hash against the Lucia userID. Declare professional outputs with purpose, audience and media type; Archive includes its report artifacts automatically. Before completion, correct declaration metadata by passing the returned declaration_sha256 as expected_declaration_sha256. File identities and bytes remain sealed; prior receipts remain available to existing handoffs.

expected_declaration_sha256.description: Returned declaration_sha256 for a correction to purpose, audience or media type before completion. Prevents overwriting another review; the agent retains this value without an additional human approval.

path.description: File path relative to this run's output_dir (for example result.pdf). Absolute paths inside output_dir and run-relative outputs/result.pdf are also accepted. An existing output-relative path takes precedence. The saved manifest always uses output-relative paths.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_complete_studio_client_workflow
tools.title: Complete a Lucia workflow run
tools.description: Mark a review-ready run completed only while every declared artifact still matches its receipt.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_recover_studio_client_ledger
tools.title: Recover Lucia customer-folder ledger
tools.description: Recover private client pointers from portable customer manifests and inspect engagement, input, and run records independently. Preserve damaged aliases and records; return healthy work alongside explicit issues and completeness flags. An incomplete inventory is not an empty archive.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_report_studio_client_retention
tools.title: Review Lucia retention candidates
tools.description: Build a non-destructive size, age, and lifecycle report. This tool never deletes customer files.

tools.name: lucia_assurance_configure_studio_archive
tools.title: Configure Lucia Studio Archive
tools.description: Set one absolute shared archive folder for this user. This writes only a private local configuration and discovers exact top-level search scopes.

archive_root.description: Absolute path to the shared or synced studio archive folder.

initialize.instructions: Use lucia_workflow_usage for task start, observed outcomes, status and task-scoped retries. Incident tools send ordinary HTTPS using the same retained local identity. Use native host linking automatically when available. The native broker's version is separate from the guest's current reporting-process and failed-worker versions. If this host route is unavailable, use the host browser at https://mparanza.com/lucia/incident-recovery with the original reporting owner and exact retained request. Never infer a computer from a browser identity or a Linux guest UUID. Never bypass a denied host operation.

tools.name: lucia_incident_host_context
tools.description: Read or create the native host's random public incident code. Never returns its private key. A Cowork Linux guest remains explicitly unlinked. This does not report a guest workflow version.

tools.name: lucia_incident_host_link
tools.description: Automatically bind a guest's existing local incident capability to this native host and app at Mparanza. Pass exactly {credentials: {installation_id, installation_key}} using the guest's existing values. The argument is credentials, not capability; do not add run_id. The host key stays out of tool results; no client files, diagnostics or commands are inputs. Does not close an incident.

tools.name: lucia_workflow_usage
tools.description: Retain and deliver one task's usage events through this installed product's native service and existing userID/computer identity. Prefer this over a shell command that cannot write the user-scoped reporting database. Start requires pipeline, observed host and sample_kind; record requires an observed kind and its optional fields. Reuse the same UUID through retries. Status verifies the same task's server identity; flush retries only that task. No client documents, paths, shell commands, credentials or global queue operations are accepted. A reporting failure does not invalidate professional work.

tools.name: lucia_workflow_stamp
tools.description: Stamp the exact retained model_data_receipt_request.json through ordinary HTTPS for a run owned by this local reporter. Supply its original run_id and receipt_request, never report contents, paths or credentials. Save the exact returned receipt beside the request, then use workflow_usage.py stamp-report and deliver its queued receipt event. Stamping does not link the receipt or prove task completion. Browser-owned runs use the browser workflow-stamp operation.

RunReceiptStampRequest.description: The complete field allow-list accepted from a Vera run.
RunReceiptStampRequest.title: RunReceiptStampRequest

tools.name: lucia_incident_register
tools.description: Register or inspect this installed product's retained local reporting identity through ordinary HTTPS. Pass no arguments. Private credentials stay in the reporter; this does not claim a browser-owned task.

tools.name: lucia_incident_report
tools.description: Automatically record an observed lucia/setup/host execution failure, with all available relevant technical evidence. No extra confirmation or feature-request form. Use a stable random report UUID for retries. For reviewed diagnostics retained after a helper failure, set evidence_for_report_id to its original report UUID; this attaches the full technical chain without creating another failure episode. Never include professional/client outputs.

TechnicalFrame.description: Package-relative source coordinates; never locals, arguments or case text.
TechnicalFrame.title: TechnicalFrame

tools.name: lucia_incident_status
tools.description: Get targeted diagnostic requests, original-task resume instructions, required updates and recovery status. Answer technical requests automatically through supplemental reports tied to the exact request revision; then check for the recovery agent's reply. Remain linked to unresolved incidents.

tools.name: lucia_incident_outcome
tools.description: Record the actual result of recovery or a resumed operation against the current remedy revision. Only actual execution success matching the original report_id and current remedy revision closes that installation's delivery.

TechnicalFrame.description: Package-relative source coordinates; never locals, arguments or case text.
TechnicalFrame.title: TechnicalFrame

tools.name: lucia_incident_progress
tools.description: Record observed remedy application or original-operation retry against its exact report and current revision. Progress never closes the original incident.

RecoveryEvent.description: An observed step for one original report and applicable remedy revision.
RecoveryEvent.title: RecoveryEvent

initialize.instructions: For archived client work, list the safe registered-client directory first. Fresh default sessions reconnect the approved root and retain private aliases; configured=false means location not connected, not an unregistered client. Reuse established choices and confirm unresolved client/source/copy scope together. If it returns configured=false and setup_required=true, tell the user that the native folder chooser will open and call setup_studio_archive before requesting an absolute path manually. Use the manual diagnose/configure fallback only when the guided tool reports archive_folder_picker_unavailable. Ask the user to choose Existing or New when no exact client is established. Resolve a user-supplied identity through the exact local resolver; never infer identity from a filename. Register a confirmed existing scope or create a new client, obtain its stable client ID, and import files only after the user authorizes the copy. Archive Organization uses the complete projected inventory and opaque item references; raw hashes, storage IDs, capabilities, and absolute paths remain local. Search one exact archive scope and open every file result used as evidence. For Gmail, use the connected Gmail read tools and fail closed on ambiguous routing.

Reuse a known stable client ID and validate its folder instead of creating a duplicate.

If ready is false, explain the cause immediately. A chat path is not a file transfer. Use a supported host transfer into an ordinary connected working folder, verify the original hashes, then import with those same hashes. Never manually write managed engagement inputs. This path importer does not transfer attachments itself.

source_paths.description: Paths of all selected files; check in batches for more than 100 files before creating records.

expected_sha256.description: Optional original file hashes, one per selected path in the same order. Required when verifying an attachment transferred between environments; compute from originals using a file tool, never invent them.

tools.title: Set up Vera Studio Archive
tools.description: Open the operating system's native folder chooser, diagnose the selected shared archive folder, and save this user's private local configuration. Use this guided action before asking the user to type an absolute path.

tools.name: diagnose_studio_archive_access
tools.title: Diagnose Studio Archive access
tools.description: Check path resolution and root listing without persisting configuration. Returns path-safe categories for host sandbox denial, SMB session or credential errors, share reachability, and share/filesystem permissions.

archive_root.description: Absolute local, mounted, or native Windows UNC path selected for the shared studio archive.

tools.name: configure_studio_archive
tools.title: Configure Vera Studio Archive
tools.description: Set one absolute shared archive folder for this user. This writes only a private local configuration and discovers exact top-level search scopes.

archive_root.description: Absolute path to the shared or synced studio archive folder.

tools.name: refresh_studio_archive
tools.title: Refresh Vera Studio Archive
tools.description: Hash every supported source, incrementally update this user's private local full-text index, adopt top-level scope changes, and report skipped or partially extracted documents. Source files are read but never modified. OCR is local-only and never downloads model weights.

rebuild.description: Discard and rebuild the derived local index.

ocr_language.description: Explicit document OCR language, independent of jurisdiction. Defaults to it.

enable_ocr.description: Try already-installed local OCR for scans and sparse PDF pages.

tools.name: search_studio_archive
tools.title: Search Vera Studio Archive
tools.description: Search one exact configured scope. Use scope_id='all' only when the user explicitly requests a studio-wide search. Results are candidates and must be opened before citation.

query.description: Compact lexical query; Claude may issue several variants.

scope_id.description: Exact scope_id returned by studio_archive_status, or all after explicit user intent.

tools.name: open_studio_archive_source
tools.title: Open and verify a Studio Archive source
tools.description: Open one search result by opaque source_id, re-hash the current file, and return its citable text and locator. Fails if the source changed after indexing.

context_chunks.description: Adjacent chunks on each side; defaults to 0.

tools.name: configure_studio_archive_client
tools.title: Register one existing Studio Archive client
tools.description: Assign a stable client ID and bind confirmed legal names, full email addresses, and tax identifiers to one exact existing archive scope in the private local registry. Vera stores no Gmail credentials, messages, or attachments.

scope_id.description: Exact client scope_id returned by studio_archive_status.

email_addresses.description: Confirmed full email or PEC addresses unique to this client.

legal_names.description: Confirmed legal names used only to find candidates, never for automatic routing.

tax_identifiers.description: Confirmed codice fiscale or partita IVA values used to find candidates.

replace_orphaned_scope_id.description: Explicitly move one listed orphaned profile to this target scope. Supply no identity arrays in the same call.

tools.name: plan_studio_archive_gmail_search
tools.title: Plan a client-scoped Gmail search
tools.description: Return bounded Gmail-native queries for one exact client scope. This local tool does not call Gmail; Claude must use the connected Gmail search/read tools and review every shortlisted message.

scope_id.description: Exact client scope_id; studio-wide Gmail search is not supported.

topic.description: Optional compact topic phrase from the user's question.

after.description: Optional inclusive lower date bound in YYYY-MM-DD.

before.description: Optional exclusive upper date bound in YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: match_studio_archive_email
tools.title: Match Gmail headers to a Studio Archive client
tools.description: Match all available Gmail From, To, Cc, and Bcc header values only against unique confirmed full addresses. Missing, incomplete, or unparseable headers fail closed.

header_addresses.description: Raw address values copied from Gmail message headers.

headers_complete.description: True only after the full message read exposed all available From, To, Cc, and Bcc fields and every non-empty value was supplied.

expected_scope_id.description: Optional selected client scope used for the fail-closed answer check.
